name: Beverley Beach
bio_draft: White-sand beach at Matei on Taveuni, named by Rough Guides for snorkelling.

name: Vidawa Rainforest Hike
bio_draft: Walk (guided rainforest hike): full-day guided hike to archaeological sites and viewpoints, ending at the lower Tavoro falls.

name: Waitavala Waterslide
bio_draft: Waterslide (natural rock slide): cool natural rock slide and swimming hole on a stream.

name: Wairiki Mission Church
bio_draft: Religious building (mission church): Taveuni Catholic church on a hill above a coconut plantation, with views of the historic battle beach.

name: Savusavu
bio_draft: Town on Vanua Levu's south coast: yachting anchorage, diving base and hot springs, the island's main tourist centre.

name: Waisali Rainforest Reserve
bio_draft: Protected rainforest reserve (nature park) just outside Savusavu, about 130 ha, with birds, frogs and a waterfall walk; run with the National Trust of Fiji.
